components.name: Mass Analyzer

components.name: Vacuum Chamber and Pump System
components.reasoning: A specialized vacuum chamber with its own high-vacuum pump system provides a controlled environment necessary to ensure accurate detection of ions without interference from ambient air molecules.

components.name: Ion Source
components.reasoning: The ion source generates ions that are then manipulated by the mass analyzer, making it an essential component for initiating the analysis process in any mass spectrometer.

components.name: Mass Spectrograph

components.name: Detector

components.name: Computer Interface and Data System

components.name: Sample Introduction Unit

components.name: Power Supply and Electronics Control Board

components.name: Operator Console

components.name: Cryogenic Coolant System (optional)

components.name: Enclosure and Mounting Frame
